title: Completed scalar restriction commutes with simultaneous derived reduction
statement: For a prime ell and a scheme W, with the four derived categories of constant ell-adic modules, their strict towers, completed coefficient modules and their strict towers, there are normalized simultaneous quotient reductions M over the completed category and N over the constant category. For every n, writing F for completed scalar restriction on derived categories and C_n,E_n for derived level evaluations, there is a natural isomorphism M.T followed by C_n and F to F followed by N.T and E_n. Its component at every P carries F(M.unit_n(P)) to N.unit_n(F(P)). This assertion involves no integral input, inverse limit, endpoint identification or arrow between endpoints.

source.place: paragraph (3), reduction of the limit map via the adjoint of each tower projection

proof.text: Use the ordinary cokernels of multiplication by ell^(n+1) to construct both quotient towers. Exact scalar restriction identifies the quotient maps and transitions. Resolve by flat-term K-flat complexes; multiplication is monic on the coefficient unit and hence on flat terms, so quotient reduction preserves quasi-isomorphisms between regular resolutions. The same resolving-class construction as for integral quotient towers constructs M and N.

The finite change-of-rings comparison is natural on those K-flat representatives and identifies the quotient insertions. Derive the ordinary square, apply uniqueness of pointwise left derived functors, and descend the quotient-unit square through localization. This gives alpha as a natural isomorphism and its normalized unit equation on every derived completed object.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_completed_reduction_restriction (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalCompleted ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalCompleted ℓ W)] :
    let F := diagonalCompletedUnderlying ℓ W
    let E := fun n : ℕ ↦
      ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod ℓ W)).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    let C := fun n : ℕ ↦
      ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalCompleted ℓ W)).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ (M : DiagonalCompletedReduction ℓ W)
      (N : DiagonalCompletedReductionData ℓ (DiagonalMod ℓ W)),
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ α : M.derived.T ⋙ C n ⋙ F ≅ F ⋙ N.derived.T ⋙ E n,
        ∀ P : DerivedCategory (DiagonalCompleted ℓ W),
          F.map ((M.unit n).app P) ≫ α.hom.app P = (N.unit n).app (F.obj P)
